results.text:

TL;DR: Aerial surveys in FMA Ia, Brazil, estimated 1183 franciscana individuals, qualifying the isolated population for Endangered IUCN Red Listing, highlighting the need for urgent management actions to mitigate unsustainable bycatch and habitat threats.
